diagnostic: Common previous-study development holdout; never an unbiased final test
selection_rule: Equal-species macro mean of common-development per-sample VDF relative-L2; electron only for fixed_ion

overlap_check.row_encoding: SHA256 of [spectrum float32, coefficient labels float32] concatenated as little-endian float32 C-order bytes
overlap_check.comparison: Common validation rows versus checkpoint actual optimization rows, not entire original training pool

r2_definition: Canonical global flattened R2 against one grand mean; float64 accumulation
vdf_truth_definition: Inverse transform of heldout target Fourier coefficients, not original sampler VDF
per_sample_index_context: Every per_sample index refers to the reference training Parquet, not the new run training Parquet
development_caution: These 750 states were already used for previous tuning and are reused adaptively; their estimates/intervals are development diagnostics. Final generalization requires the untouched new test set.
